messages:
maria (partnerships): Quick sync request — want to align on a joint ISV bundle (LangChain + LlamaIndex + our gateway adapter), a short HW benchmark run for marketplace listing, and a coordinated announcement window. TL;DR: who owns which asset and dates?
kevin (eng-ml): I can lead the HW bench runs. Need clarity on target models + sequence lengths. Suggest: 8k context, q4-small/medium models, and one larger Llama variant for perf numbers.
sasha (product): For compatibility matrix we should list required adapter API surfaces (runner, toolkit, connector). I'll draft the matrix — need input from kevin on quantized model build variants.
maria (partnerships): Good. @kevin — can you confirm testbed: 2x A10G + reference NVMe? Also need a short repro script we can include in the marketplace listing.
kevin (eng-ml): Yes to A10G baseline. I'll produce a 1-page README + a small script:
```
# bench example
python run_bench.py --model rlc-small --batch 4 --context 8192 --device cuda:0
```
Will also export top-line numbers (p50 latency, tokens/sec, cost-est).
liam (sales): From GTM side we need a one-pager and 2 slide deck variants: one for SI partners (technical) and one for marketplace listing (buyer-focused). Olga, can marketing help with the buyer deck?
olga (marketing): Yes. We'll need the bench highlights, three customer-facing benefit bullets, and logo lockups for LangChain/LlamaIndex. Also ask legal about co-marketing approvals.
maria (partnerships): Legal check noted. Proposed timeline: bench runs and matrix by Wed 1767810200, decks by Fri 1767810500, embargoed announcement early next week. Thoughts?
sasha (product): Works for me if kevin's numbers are in by Wed. Also want to include a brief Rollout plan for Dedicated vs Hosted availability — I'll draft that and add to the slides.
kevin (eng-ml): I can hit Wed but need test cases from LangChain adapter folks — specifically one complex retrieval-augmented generation flow + a plain generation flow. @maria can you get a contact at LangChain for sample pipeline configs?
maria (partnerships): Reaching out now — pinged @langchain-team via partner channel. If we get those by EOD tomorrow, kevin can run the tests.
olga (marketing): Can we pre-write social copy with placeholders for numbers? That speeds approval. I'll drop a doc in the shared drive and tag everyone.
liam (sales): Also flagging a marketplace SKUs question — pricing tier suggestion: free trial + metered usage. Partnerships/legal to confirm.
maria (partnerships): Action items: 1) kevin: bench + script (due 1767810200) 2) sasha: compatibility matrix + rollout note (due 1767810200) 3) olga: buyer deck + social copy draft (due 1767810500) 4) liam: pricing proposal for marketplace (due 1767810400) 5) maria: partner contact + co-marketing approvals (ongoing). React with :white_check_mark: when you accept.
kevin (eng-ml): :white_check_mark: I'll start runs tonight.
sasha (product): :white_check_mark: drafting now.
olga (marketing): :white_check_mark: will post doc in ~1h.
liam (sales): :white_check_mark: looping legal.
marketbot: Note — added a joint-announcement label and created a calendar placeholder for next-week launch window.
maria (partnerships): Perfect — I'll follow up with LangChain contact + update this thread with their sample configs once I hear back. Thanks all! :tada:
